relations.subject: Tenga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: As he grew older, he studied at Benchen Monastery

relations.subject: Tenga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: was eventually given the name Karma Tenzin Thinle Namgyal from Situ Rinpoche. Soon after, he was given ordination by Situ Rinpoche

relations.subject: Tenga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In India, he settled at Rumtek Monastery, the main seat of the 16th Karmapa. Tenga Rinpoche served the 16th Karmapa for seventeen years, nine of those years in the position of Dorje Lopön.

relations.subject: Tenga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1976 Tenga Rinpoche settled in Swayambhunath, Nepal, where he founded a second Benchen Monastery

relations.subject: Tenga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1986, Tenga Rinpoche established the new Benchen Monastery in Kathmandu.
